about: Targets ContextGapAgent's shared gate (context_gap_gate@v1) must reach on context_gap_golden.json: gap_recall (gap windows the gate opens for / gap windows), false_gap_rate (no-gap windows it opens for / no-gap windows) and query_hit_rate (opened gap windows whose standalone query names the topic). Measured on the first live run (Haiku 5.5, thinking disabled on triage). The one miss: 'explained-in-window' (the reference is restated in the same window) opened at 0.6. Each bound allows one more case of run-to-run variance (9 gap windows, 9 no-gap windows): a new prompt must at least match them.
